subject: Order Form — phased pricing & invoice routing (redline v3)
content:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@opticloud.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: priya.reddy@opticloud.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft order form: pricing phasing proposal

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached is our first-pass direction on the Order Form. High-level: OptiCloud is asking to phase the committed spend into quarterly tranches (Q1/Q2 ramp), with invoicing on a quarterly cadence tied to tranche delivery.

Key asks from procurement:
- Net 60 on all invoices (OptiCloud standard)
- Reverse-charge/VAT self-assessment language for EU entities
- Single payer entity: OptiCloud Inc. (US) — will confirm tax ID in a PO
- No proration of activation fee for partial quarter usage

We redlined the Order Form and sent it as OptiCloud_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (attached). Please review the pricing table — we proposed a stepped price that discounts at 250k and 500k annualized ARR.

Can you confirm Redwood's position on net terms and the activation fee proration? Procurement needs a response this week to lock budget planning.

Best,
Sam Torres
Head of Procurement, OptiCloud
Attachment: OptiCloud_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (stub)

----------
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@opticloud.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form: pricing phasing proposal

Sam — thanks for the draft and clear asks. Looping in Ben + Karthik for commercial and approval routing. Quick initial responses below; detailed redline attached (OptiCloud_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf).

1) Net terms: Our standard is Net 30. For strategic pilots we can accommodate extended terms with conditions. Proposed path: Net 45 for first two quarters tied to a minimum committed spend (>= $500k ARR) or an upfront tranche payment covering Q1. Otherwise Net 30.

2) Activation fee proration: we usually prorate activation fees for partial-quarter usage (customer-friendly). If procurement insists on no proration, we need to escalate offset language (e.g., upfront crediting of next quarter).

3) VAT/Reverse charge: we will accept a VAT self-assessment clause for EU entities provided OptiCloud provides the validated VAT registration and evidence and accepts responsibility for withholding. We will add an audit-evidence clause.

4) Entity & PO: fine to invoice OptiCloud Inc (US) once you confirm tax ID and PO routing. Finance prefers to have explicit Invoice Remit details in Exhibit B.

Next steps (ask of OptiCloud): please confirm whether you want
- Net 60 as a hard ask (we should avoid unless tied to a commensurate commit)
- Whether activation fee is non-prorated (yes/no)

Internal: Ben — can we support Net 45 for first half if OptiCloud signs a 12-month mincommit >= $500k? Karthik — need legal check on the VAT audit-evidence wording in the redline.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: OptiCloud_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (Redwood redline: pricing table updated, added Exhibit B invoice remit template)

----------
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, Sam Torres <sam.torres@opticloud.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form: pricing phasing proposal

Kim / Sam — quick note from sales: we support Net 45 for the first two quarters if OptiCloud agrees to the 12-month minimum commit (>= $500k). Also willing to accept non-proration of the activation fee if OptiCloud adds the upfront Q1 tranche.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood

----------
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@opticloud.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@opticloud.com>, priya.reddy@opticloud.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form: pricing phasing proposal (OptiCloud redline comments)

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and the v3 redline. A few points from OptiCloud Legal: 

- Net terms: OptiCloud requires Net 60 as standard. Our CFO has approved Net 45 as a concession, but only with a contractual indemnity covering tax withholding and with a clause limiting service-credit remedies in lieu of late payment damages.
- Taxes: we need a clearer reverse-charge/VAT clause that explicitly states customer self-assesses VAT for the EU entities and indemnifies Redwood against tax liabilities arising from our misclassification.
- Activation fee: Procurement prefers the activation fee to be non-prorated; Legal will accept non-proration if there's an express early-termination credit for unused tranches.
- PO requirement: OptiCloud will provide a PO for the initial tranche; please confirm Redwood's invoicing address and whether Redwood can accept consolidated quarterly invoices versus per-tranche invoices.

I've attached our redline (OptiCloud_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf) with inline comments. We are open to Net 45 if the indemnities and PO flow are acceptable; otherwise Net 60 remains the baseline.

Regards,
Olivia Grant
Sr. Counsel, OptiCloud
Attachment: OptiCloud_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (OptiCloud inline comments)

----------
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@opticloud.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@opticloud.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form: pricing phasing proposal (Redwood response & action items)

Olivia/Sam — thanks for the comments, noted. Summary of Redwood's position after internal review (legal + finance + sales):

- Net terms: Redwood can accept Net 45 for the first 6 months (two quarters) as a commercial concession if OptiCloud: (a) executes a 12-month minimum commit >= $500k, or (b) posts an upfront tranche covering Q1. After the concession period, standard terms revert to Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated in renewal.

- Indemnity & taxes: we will accept a VAT self-assessment clause, but cannot accept an open-ended tax indemnity that shifts all tax risk to Redwood. Proposed compromise: OptiCloud indemnifies Redwood only to the extent of proven tax liability resulting from OptiCloud's failure to provide accurate tax registration or to follow the agreed reverse-charge process. Redwood will add an audit-evidence requirement (validated VAT registration + mirror of invoice).

- Activation fee: we can accept non-proration if OptiCloud provides an upfront tranche equal to Q1 activation + committed token tranche. If OptiCloud prefers consolidated quarterly invoicing, Redwood Finance needs the PO and remit-to details in Exhibit B (template attached).

Action items: 
- OptiCloud: confirm PO remit-to entity + whether you will provide Q1 upfront tranche (Sam/Priya) — due EOD Friday.
- OptiCloud Legal: confirm acceptance of the limited indemnity language we proposed in OptiCloud_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf.
- Redwood Legal (Karthik): please review the VAT/audit-evidence language in the attached and confirm we are comfortable with the scope.
- Sales (Ben): confirm that the commercial concession (Net 45) is acceptable conditioned on the 12-month threshold — Ben unblocked?

If everyone is aligned we can push to DocuSign next week. I attached the updated pricing table (OptiCloud_Pricing_Table_Q3-Q4.xlsx) and our redline for legal (OptiCloud_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: OptiCloud_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf, OptiCloud_Pricing_Table_Q3-Q4.xlsx

----------
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@opticloud.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@opticloud.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft order form: pricing phasing proposal (final internal guidance)

Team — I reviewed the v3 redline and the OptiCloud comments. Approve the commercial compromise: Net 45 limited to first two quarters with the 12-month mincommit or Q1 upfront.

Legal instruction to our counsel: tighten the indemnity language so it is limited to OptiCloud-originated tax errors (must be proven) and add explicit audit windows (90 days after invoice). Finance: prepare a consolidated quarterly invoice template and test remit flow once OptiCloud confirms PO.

Ben — give me a final confirmation in the thread that you communicate the 12-month threshold to OptiCloud procurement; they need that to unblock Net 45. Marissa — please schedule an internal handoff with Finance Ops for invoice routing (cc'ing them on the HubSpot deal).

I'll mark this green to proceed to signature once Sam confirms PO remit and OptiCloud Legal accepts the limited indemnity.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Legal & Compliance (interim)
